newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Samanda in timber talks.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Samanda in timber talks.

text.p: Samanda Holdings Bhd said it is in the final stages of talks to acquire "certain material assets" involved in timber and timber-related activities.

In a brief statement released late on Friday, the company said a full announcement would be made "in due course" after conclusion of the talks. It did not name the seller of the assets or disclose a price.
Shares of Samanda, an investment holding and management services firm, were last traded at 16.90 ringgit on September 13. Its stock has been suspended for a company announcement.
